name: idle_fly
description: Relaxed hovering; four wingbeats, legs hang with bent knees and a slow sway

name: idle_fly_watch
description: Hovering with a searching head tilt and six asymmetric wingbeats; legs hang loose

name: hover_menacing
description: Braced hovering, five fast beats, curled claws, fixed stare; legs hang loose

name: fly_menacing
description: Forward flight posture with three fast beats; host supplies travel toward the player

name: land
description: Brake, lower and straighten the legs and settle; host supplies descent

name: idle_ground
description: Planted feet, slow breathing and small head motion

name: takeoff
description: Gather, unfold and push off, legs loosen as it lifts; host supplies ascent

name: glide_retreat
description: Quiet retreating flight with trailing, loosely hanging limbs

name: screech
description: Chest and head recoil, claw flare; aligned to the scream

name: lunge
description: Anticipation, forward reach and threatening hold; host supplies rush

name: ground_loom
description: Grounded threat with half-open wings and a lowered head

name: telepathy
description: Almost motionless grounded stare, restrained breathing

name: window_stare
description: Head canted toward the light with a lifted hand

name: door_bang
description: Two forearm strikes, timed at 0.3 and 1.4 seconds

name: enter_glide
description: Narrow silhouette and forward reach for the cabin doorway; legs trail loose
